description: Total irrigation by crop in the Continental United States from 2008 to 2020 is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by P. J. Ruess et al. We provide a dataset of irrigation water withdrawals by crop, county, year, and water source within the United States. We employ a framework we previously developed to establish a companion dataset to our original estimates. The main difference is that we now use the U.S. Coverage: national (US); published in 2024. Formats: Excel, TXT, ZIP. The data are held in University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
